title: Data Type Conversion
source_docs: DSP System Toolbox HDL Support/Signal Management/Data_Type_Conversion.md
text: Convert input signal to specified data type, 1 input, 1 output, direct feedthrough, {Mode} sets Select data type mode; {Output minimum} sets the minimum output value for range checking, {Output maximum} sets the maximum output value for range checking, {Output data type}, {Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools} sets the option to prevent fixed-point tools from overriding Output data, {Input and output to have equal} sets the constraint for converting fixed-point data types Real World, {Integer rounding mode} sets the rounding mode for fixed-point operations, {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the method of overflow action, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets the interval between samples, {Data type override} sets the data type override mode for this signal, {Signedness} sets the signed, {Scaling} sets the method for scaling fixed-point data Best, {Word length} sets the bit size of the word that holds the quantized, {Fraction length} sets the fraction length for fixed-point data type, {Slope} sets the slope for the fixed-point data and {Bias} sets the bias for the fixed-point data type. Values come from the instance.

ports.summary: Input signal scalar | vector | matrix | N-D array

ports.summary: Output signal scalar | vector | matrix | N-D array

params.name: Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools
params.values: Option to prevent fixed-point tools from overriding Output data type off (default) | on

params.name: Input and output to have equal
params.values: Constraint for converting fixed-point data types Real World Value (RWV) (default) | Stored Integer (SI)

params.name: Integer rounding mode
params.values: Specify the rounding mode for fixed-point operations Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: Method of overflow action off (default) | on

params.name: Mode
params.values: Select data type mode Inherit (default) | Built in | Fixed Point

params.values: Specify data type override mode for this signal Inherit | Off

params.name: Signedness

params.name: Scaling
params.values: Method for scaling fixed-point data Best precision (default) | Binary point | Slope and bias

params.values: Bit size of the word that holds the quantized integer 16 (default) | integer from 0 to 32

params.values: Specify fraction length for fixed-point data type 0 (default) | scalar integer
